limitations: Modeled CAMS air quality data at ~0.1° (~11 km) grid resolution smooths hyper-local roadside or construction spikes.
Manual monitor calibration scales the 24-hour curve uniformly around the selected hour; low-cost optical sensors can overestimate at high humidity (>75% RH).
Indoor Exposure Index is a transparent heuristic score (0–100), not a direct sensor measurement or clinical health risk score.
Health advisories summarize public MoHFW/NCDC guidance and are not medical advice.
INR cost ranges and payback estimates are planning benchmarks; verify current local equipment and tariff prices before purchase.
